records.subject: Confirming cancellation for North Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

This confirms the cancellation of your Wrenfield plan. Sorry to see North Dynamics go -- if there's feedback on what didn't work, I'd genuinely like to hear it.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get North Dynamics set up
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no tickets, and no customer reply to either outreach (email:2cd0c9ec, email:5e922ae7). A getting started call was held 07-23 (calendar:dc686281) yet still no activity 4 days later, suggesting low self-serve momentum; Pro plan and attended call give some chance within the 8 remaining days.

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks again for joining the getting started call last week. Following up on what we covered: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so setting up one real project is the quickest way to see how North Dynamics would use it. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready for the team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you live.

Best,
Priya
